comment: World (iii) of the families round, matter and the binding holder (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work, the owner's 'run the experiment' of 12:35 read as this world; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md, The two rows, The reach of a held family is its pair, The algebra of clusters (5), The click joins and parts): two compact pixels of the matter family, `quanta` quanta each in the engine's count, at the Nodes `centres` on the open box of `shape`, `apart` Links apart along x, on the rule's own universe (examples/events/rule.json, the binding holder [2400, 2401] at the level weight 1, the law's strong force), laid by the generator in two passes (on main 3fe40aeb's engine the lay gave two compact pixels, the clock pairs [12741, 8274] and [12862, 8365], 9,588 and 11,310 quanta read at the start; the worlds are laid anew on the finished engine; two bodies' regions share no Node, so the least distance the lattice allows between two compact pixels is about twice a region's reach, five Links or more; the advisor's d = 3 is under it). Two declared regions, a box of Nodes about each body, whose `field` lines report the matter family's share in quanta over the region each interval it changes (a GameBoard reading): the two counts over the run, their swing and any transfer. Headless, `ticks` intervals; the reading at the window's ends by tools/body_rest.py (the two bodies' centroids and their separation along x, the holder's level along each axis from each centre, the rotation at each centre), and the field lines by the same tool with the run's output. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it.
reading: per world (tools/body_rest.py, GameBoard): at the window's ends each body's 2 cos omega_b at its centre, its quanta over its half of the board, the centroid of its share and the separation of the two centroids along x with its change; the binding holder's level at r = 0 through 6 along each axis from each centre (along +x from the second body and -x from the first the ray leaves the pair); and with the run's output the `field` lines of the regions `first` and `second`, each count's least and largest over the window with their intervals and the count of its local maxima.

blind.range: cosh kappa_b = 3 den_b / num_b - 2 = 1.00125 at [2400, 2401], kappa_b = 0.0500 per Link, R = 1 / kappa_b = 20.0 Links; the holder's rest about a source falls as e^(-r / 20) / r beyond a few Links (Yukawa's line): the ratio of successive levels along a ray leaving the pair is e^(-1 / 20) r / (r + 1) far from the body, the tail's own ratio within it; at the Node the first look's field 1,053 at 2,000 in the advisor's unit (row (s))
blind.beat: two pixels at d Links swing their counts at the beat omega_b e^(-kappa d) per interval with the pixel's own kappa and return, a net transfer second order (The algebra of clusters (5)); at d = 3 and kappa = 0.45 the beat is 0.26 omega_b; at this world's d = 12 and this pixel's kappa (about 1.5 per Link from the lay's tail ratio 0.22, the advisor's 1.27 at 0.417 Gamma) the beat is e^(-18) of omega_b, under one swing in 400 intervals: the two counts stand within their rounding walk, the field lines' least and largest within a few quanta of the lay, no local maximum of a swing
blind.join_and_parting: the join within tail reach and the parting beyond it are runs of clicks, one quantum whole per click; at d = 12 the tails do not reach (e^(-kappa d) under 10^-7) and the holder's pull alone moves the bodies: both drawn toward each other, the separation's change below 0; its size by the fall line with the compact pixel's suppression, a = 0.11 x Delta |d omega_0 / dc| grad c at c / Gamma about 0.25 to 0.5, grad c the partner's level gradient at 12 Links, 0.2387 x s_b e^(-12 / 20) (1 / 12 + 1 / 20) / 12 levels per Link with s_b the partner's well per interval: of the order of a few Links closing over 400 intervals, the first order's estimate from the law's lines and the lay's well, read against the single pixel of examples/events/matter_alone/pixel.json (its own centroid at rest)
blind.coupling: the binding holder is read by the pace as gravity is and differs from it by its divisor alone (E_s = 1 against LW), so its coupling between two quanta is gravity's times LW; at the lattice's scale it binds the generator's bodies (alpha_b about 10^-4 at [2, 3] and C alpha_b of order one), at nature's numbers alpha_b < 10^-27 and the two rows' holder binds no nucleus (the advisor's computation, #1563 comment 5928974510; a hypothesis by name in ALGEBRA.md)
blind.status: computed from the law's lines at Gamma = 6,000, nothing read back from a run; the beat's and the parting's sizes at this world's d are the first order's estimates with the lay's own kappa and well, written before the run
blind.fence: GameBoard: a level, a centroid and a count over a region are readings and no click; the join and the parting as clicks are a cluster's round
